subject: Close cadence replan: tight-window mitigation & MAP ledger
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily@helixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: HelixHealth Procurement <procure@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Close cadence concerns and acceptance window

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Quick note from procurement: we have an internal approval slot that slid by two weeks because our security vetting queue got bumped. That pushes our original acceptance target out and creates a risk to our planned go-live window.

We need a concrete mitigation path so internal stakeholders can decide whether to accept the new timeline or request rollback options. Can Redwood provide: 
- an updated MAP that shows a compressed acceptance path, clearly enumerated owner responsibilities, and conditional cutover options,
- a summary of what evidence (SOC2, audit logs, retention policy) we need to unblock the security review faster, and
- any short-term credits or invoice deferrals you can offer if the PO timing is delayed.

I've attached the current procurement timeline we shared internally for context (procurement-timeline.xlsx).

If possible, can we get a proposed MAP rebaseline by EOD tomorrow? We have an exec sync scheduled next week and want a clean ask.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Zhang
VP Product, HelixHealth


From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Close cadence concerns and acceptance window

Emily —

Thanks for the heads up and for the timeline attachment. Apologies the vetting queue bumped you — I agree we should rebaseline the MAP and enumerate rapid unblock steps. I put together an initial proposed replan and a tight-window mitigation ledger (attached: MAP_v2.xlsx). High-level proposal below: 

Proposed rebaseline (compressed path):
- Week 0 (today): Redwood delivers MAP_v2 with two conditional acceptance dates and clear owner list.
- Week 1: Security evidence handoff (SOC2 summary + audit log extract). Neha will own producing the evidence package.
- Week 2: Procurement PO approval window (Helix expedited).
- Week 3: Canaries + acceptance testing (reduced scope canary to shorten validation).

Mitigations and commitments: 
- Redwood will prepare a SOC2 evidence summary and an audit-log export within 48 hours (attachment: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf).
- Offer: if PO date slides beyond Week 2 we can provide a one-time 10% credit on the month of first production for schedule slippage, conditioned on Helix confirming a revised PO target.
- Fallback: if acceptance cannot happen in Week 3, we propose a staggered cutover that isolates the customer-sensitive workload — allows go-live on a subset to preserve critical timelines.

Please confirm if the above looks feasible on your side; if so I'll route the MAP_v2 to your procurement and copy Neha for the evidence handoff. If you want an executive note, Marissa is available to join the sync.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (proposed milestones & owners), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (high-level evidence list).

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0182

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Close cadence concerns and acceptance window — need swift approvals and evidence pack

Forwarding Emily's procurement note. Key asks: expedited MAP rebaseline (done, see MAP_v2), SOC2 evidence summary (attached), and approval authority for a short-term credit contingent on PO delay.

Marissa — can you sign off on the 10% one-time credit conditioned on a PO slip to Week 4+? If we need broader executive support for the sync next week, would appreciate you on the thread.
Neha — can you assemble the evidence package and ensure the audit-log extract is generated within 48 hours? Procurement will want clear filenames and retention dates.

Subject: Re: Close cadence replan: tight-window mitigation & MAP ledger

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP_v2 doc. Procurement reviewed the compressed milestones and the SOC2 summary. We can target the conditional PO in Week 2 as you outlined provided Neha's team can deliver the audit-log extracts by Friday.

We appreciate the conditional credit offer — procurement will include that as part of the negotiation buffer if the PO timing slips. For now, we are proceeding with the rebaseline and I confirmed an exec sync for 2027-04-08 where we'll present MAP_v2 and the updated acceptance ask.

Action items we committed to: 
- Helix: expedite internal approval; provide PO target by 2027-04-07.
- Redwood (Neha): deliver audit-log extract and SOC2 evidence file by 2027-04-02EOD.
- Ben / Marissa: standby for exec sync on 2027-04-08.

I'll loop in procurement and send a calendar invite for the exec sync.

Best,
Emily
VP Product, HelixHealth
